title: Add Press, setup-gate, Mint-capacity, and Mint-overlap fixtures
objective: Add deterministic write-path and Mint reliability fixtures covering the reported write failure and Mint defects: Press with intent 19:00 versus Todoist 23:00Z/19:00 local, skeleton runstate without explicit Day Setup, configured 300 Mint minutes versus the prior 60-minute/2-block fallback, selected Mint intervals with overlapping assigned tasks, shifted Mint readback, and exact Trinoor classification.
acceptance_criteria_met: Fixtures reproduce the original Press mismatch before normalization and pass after FEEDBACK-23: backend test_press_repro_before_normalization parses the raw fixed due wall clock ('2026-07-12T23:00:00Z' -> '23:00'), asserts it differs from the 19:00 intent (the exact reported failure), then proves commit._todoist_due_reading normalizes 23:00Z through America/New_York to '19:00' and write_todoist verifies clean with empty verify_failures; equivalent-encoding, floating-local, true-mismatch (12h message, no raw 24h), missing-timezone fail-closed, and structured canonical detail tests pin the same contract.

Fixtures prove missing Day Setup blocks external writes after FEEDBACK-24: a /gather-materialised skeleton runstate reads is_day_setup_confirmed False and /plan-inputs day_setup_confirmed False; /commit?mode=live returns 409 with zero vault bytes written (byte-for-byte before/after compare); /runtime-actions apply and undo both return 409; only a successful POST /day-setup then unblocks a live commit (200 ok with fake providers).

Fixtures prove 300-minute Mint configuration yields the expected blocks/intents and no hardcoded 2-block fallback: resolved_day_semantics effective_allotment_minutes 300 yields the aggregate Minting row with blocks == 10 and duration == 300 (dated work_allotment_minutes 300 does the same); capacity _capacity_frame reserves mint == 10; 10 selected sessions total 10 blocks and suppress the aggregate; the hardcoded 2-block default is pinned as surviving ONLY when no allotment context exists.

Fixtures prove tasks overlapping Mint are rejected or explicitly infeasible: validate_sequence hard-rejects an assigned row overlapping a selected Mint session (no overlap-grant escape, Mint row itself exempt, back-to-back touch allowed); the /validate-sequence route rejects the same shape; frontend planOverflow moves a dropped row straddling a Mint interval after it and reports rows no gap can hold as explicit 'overflow infeasible' — never staged over Mint.

Fixtures prove shifted Mint readback fails and exact readback passes: ShiftingStore repro (intended 13:00-14:00 reads back 13:30-14:30) yields ok False with structured kind='calendar' verify_details (start/end ISO mismatches); an end-only drift records duration_min 60 vs 30; FakeStore exact identity passes with empty verify_failures/verify_details; a same-title source event on another calendar is never treated as our write (created_calls 1, noops empty).

Fixtures assert no real writer calls; no live POST, external write, restart, or commit: backend read pipeline fake records exactly auth_status/calendars/query_events and its writer methods raise AssertionError tripwires; write fakes (FakeTodoist/FakeStore/ShiftingStore) expose no http/client/session/base_url/token handle; frontend spies assert liveCommit/shadowCommit/runtimeAction/undoRuntimeAction are never called during load -> setup -> sequence; safety_proof below records zero live calls, writes, restarts, and Git mutations.

classes.TestPressDueFixture: Press due (FEEDBACK-23): 6 tests — original raw-wall mismatch repro then normalized pass, 23:00Z/19:00 equivalent encoding, floating local due, true different instant fails with 12h only, missing timezone fails closed, structured detail keeps canonical ISO/timezone/24h.
classes.TestSetupGateBlocksExternalWrites: Setup gate (FEEDBACK-24): 4 tests — /gather skeleton not confirmed, live commit 409 with zero vault bytes, runtime apply/undo 409, confirmed setup unblocks live commit with fakes.
classes.TestMintCapacity300: Mint capacity (FEEDBACK-25): 5 tests — 300-min allotment -> 10 blocks/300 min, dated override same, 2-block default only without allotment context, capacity frame reserves mint 10, 10 selected sessions total 10 blocks.
classes.TestMintOverlapRejected: Mint overlap (FEEDBACK-25): 4 tests — overlap hard rejection, no grant escape, back-to-back touch allowed, Mint row itself exempt.
classes.TestMintOverlapRoute: Mint overlap route: 2 tests — /validate-sequence rejects overlap, allows clean rows beside the selected session.
classes.TestMintReadback: Mint readback (FEEDBACK-26): 4 tests — shifted interval fails with structured details, duration shift fails, exact identity passes, source same-title event not our write.
classes.TestTrinoorExactClassification: Trinoor (FEEDBACK-26): 3 tests — canonical '🟡 Trinoor : Morning' is Step D'; 'Trinoor sync' is Step E not D'; 'Trinoorish' is plain Step D.
classes.TestZeroRealWriterCalls: Zero writers: 2 tests — calendar read pipeline records only read verbs; write fakes expose no live provider handle.

fixture_helpers.mint300Inputs: PlanInputs with effectiveAllotmentMinutes 300, capacity.mint 10 (never 2), anchor 08:00 eod 18:00 totalBlocks 20.
fixture_helpers.mint300Sequence: 10 selected Mint session rows 08:30-13:30 with wire.mint_session/source schedulable markers plus 3 placed work rows; mintWalls resolves 10 intervals.
fixture_helpers.DrawerHost: Preact h/Fragment render (no JSX — .ts target) mirroring App.tsx drawer lifecycle.

regression_contracts.FEEDBACK-23_press_due: Raw fixed UTC wall clock 23:00 != intent 19:00 (the original mismatch); normalized 23:00Z through America/New_York == 19:00 local passes; true different instant fails with 12h text and canonical machine detail.
regression_contracts.FEEDBACK-24_setup_gate: Skeleton /gather runstate never confirms; live commit and runtime actions fail closed 409 with zero vault bytes; only POST /day-setup unlocks.
regression_contracts.FEEDBACK-25_mint_capacity: 300-minute configuration derives 10 blocks / 300 minutes in rows and capacity; hardcoded 2-block default survives only without allotment context.
regression_contracts.FEEDBACK-25_mint_walls: Selected Mint intervals are hard walls: overlap hard-rejected at validate_sequence and /validate-sequence; frontend free-gap scan never stages over Mint and reports infeasibility explicitly.
regression_contracts.FEEDBACK-26_mint_readback: Shifted interval readback fails with structured kind='calendar' mismatch details; exact identity passes; source same-title events never collapse TDTB-owned writes.
regression_contracts.FEEDBACK-26_trinoor_exact: Step D' is exactly '[🟡 ]Trinoor : <slot>'; 'Trinoor sync'/'Trinoorish' keep Step E/D.
regression_contracts.zero_writer_calls: Backend read pipeline records only read verbs with writer tripwires; frontend writer spies never fire through load -> setup -> sequence.
